defs.meaning: 归寡妇所得的亡夫遗产的三分之一；（商品的）三等品

examples.en: Two thirds of the region has been deforested in the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去十年里这个地区的森林有三分之二被毁掉。

examples.en: About two-thirds of adults consult their doctor at least once a year.
examples.zh: 大约三分之二的成年人一年至少看一次医生。

examples.en: A two thirds majority is needed to make changes.
examples.zh: 需要2/3的多数人同意才能做改变。
